Title: Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Generic Log Analytics Integration

Body.Content:
Azure HorizonDB now supports integration with Azure Monitor diagnostic settings, enabling you to send database logs and diagnostic data to Azure Log Analytics. This provides a centralized way to query and analyze database activity, troubleshoot issues, and monitor your HorizonDB environment alongside other Azure resources.

Learn more.
